title: An Artificial-Compressibility Physics-Informed Neural Network for the Unsteady Incompressible Navier--Stokes Equations
summary: We study a physics-informed neural network (PINN) for the unsteady, two-dimensional incompressible Navier--Stokes equations in which the stiff divergence-free constraint is replaced by an artificial-compressibility (AC) relaxation governed by a single scalar parameter $\eps$. The relaxation reintroduces a pressure time derivative, converting a differential-algebraic constraint into an ordinary residual that a PINN can minimise directly.
